newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - DOMESTIC MARKET SOARES.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - DOMESTIC MARKET SOARES.

text.p: The Botswana domestic market
soared to a fifth consecutive high in the week ending March 21
and stood at 398.80 points from the previous week's 386.66.
The Foreign Companies Index dropped during the week to
391.06 from an earlier 392.10 and the All Companies Index (ACI)
slid slightly down to 391.27 from a previous 391.96 points.
Trade in the domestic sector was down to 788,505 shares
worth 2.9 million pula against the previous week's 5,596,464
shares worth 15.2 million pula.
On the domestic board five counters rose: Barclays Bank of
Botswana put on 45 thebe to close at 600 thebe,
Botswana Insurance Holdings rose five thebe to 220,
First National Bank of Botswana increased by 10 thebe
to 485, brewery holding company Sechaba added five
thebe to 280 and Standard Chartered Bank Botswana grew
30 thebe to 545.
Trading unchanged for security group Inco , clothing
chain Pep Botswana Holdings , miller and food wholesaler
Sefalana . Untraded were oil company Engen ,
food and tobacco wholesaler Metsef , variable loan stock
company RDC Properties and investment company Kgoloya
Sechaba .
On the foreign board Regent Undervalued Assets Africa
Fund did not trade and De Beers moved 400
shares among a number of individual investors.
